svg.aria-label: Tunepac pipeline in three stages. Validate: config.yaml goes through the Pydantic schema; an invalid config stops with a lint-style error report, exit 1, before any GPU work. Prepare: tokenizer and chat template, dataset converted to messages then text, base model loaded in 4-bit for QLoRA. Train and export: TRL SFTTrainer with packing and LoRA writes an adapter, and tunepac export merges it into a model that loads without PEFT.
